# Publii Static CMS
> Desktop, offline-first, open-source Static Site CMS for creating fast, secure static websites. WordPress-like simplicity with one-click deployment; GDPR & CCPA compliant. Built with Electron + Vue.js.

## Quick facts
- Version: 0.47.5 (build 17411), updated 2026-01-22
- License: GPL-3.0
- Platforms: Windows 10+ (64-bit), macOS 11+, Linux (64-bit)
- Tech stack: Electron, Vue.js, Handlebars, HTML, CSS

## The main Publii website is available at:
- English: [https://getpublii.com/](https://getpublii.com/)
- German: [https://getpublii.com/de/](https://getpublii.com/de/)
- Polish: [https://getpublii.com/pl/](https://getpublii.com/pl/)

## Key resources
- [Download](https://getpublii.com/download/): Latest installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with release info and system requirements.
- [Website](https://getpublii.com/): Overview of Publii’s features, value propositions, and key entry points
- [GitHub](https://github.com/GetPublii/Publii): Source code, issues, discussions, releases, and project roadmap.
- [Changelog](https://getpublii.com/blog/releases/): Version-by-version release notes with dates, highlights, fixes, and breaking changes.
- [Docs (user)](https://getpublii.com/docs/): How-to guides for setup, writing, theming basics, hosting, and deployment.
- [Docs (dev)](https://getpublii.com/dev/): Theme architecture, Handlebars templates, helpers, development patterns, and APIs.
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.getpublii.com/): Official themes and plugins with install/purchase links and documentation.
- [Blog](https://getpublii.com/blog/): Articles on releases, tutorials, use cases, and best practices for building and deploying static sites with Publii.
- [Community](https://github.com/GetPublii/Publii/discussions): QandA, troubleshooting, feature requests, and community support.

## Product pillars
- [Static vs Dynamic Websites: A Complete Comparison Between Publii CMS and WordPress](https://getpublii.com/static-vs-dynamic-comparison/): Compare static and dynamic websites across speed, security, SEO, privacy, maintenance and hosting cost. See why a static CMS like Publii can be a faster WordPress alternative.
- [Get a fast, secure website that's optimized for AI understanding and search engine visibility](https://getpublii.com/seo-performance/): Publii generates fast static HTML, clean URLs, metadata, sitemaps, structured data and optimized images to help search engines and AI systems understand your website.
- [Protect users' data with GDPR-compliant, privacy-focused website.](https://getpublii.com/privacy-focused/): Publii helps you build privacy-first static websites with no database, no server-side tracking and no telemetry. Work locally, publish securely and support GDPR/CCPA-friendly workflows.
- [Simple, lightweight CMS built for independent content creators.](https://getpublii.com/content-writing/): Write, edit and publish content with Publii’s desktop CMS. Use Markdown, WYSIWYG or block editing, optimize images, manage posts and publish a fast static website without coding.

## Resources
- [FAQ](https://getpublii.com/faq/): Discover what static websites are, how they compare to dynamic platforms like WordPress, and why static CMS solutions offer faster, safer, and more privacy-friendly web publishing.
- [Press & Brand Assets](https://getpublii.com/press-and-brand-assets/): Official press kit for Publii: logos, icons, screenshots, and brand usage rules for media, blogs, and conference materials.
- [Showcase](https://getpublii.com/showcase/): Explore the Publii Showcase to see a collection of stunning and versatile websites created with Publii CMS. Get inspired and start building your own unique website today.
- [About](https://getpublii.com/about/): Get to know the people and philosophy behind Publii, and why we’re committed to fast, secure, GDPR-friendly static websites.
